summary.name: Table Tool
summary.one_liner: Table Tool is a simple macOS CSV editor that auto-detects CSV format details and lets you view, edit, and convert CSV files in a grid.
use_cases: Opening CSV files with unknown delimiter or encoding
Editing cells, rows and columns of CSV files
Converting CSV files to a different format
Creating new CSV files for exchange with spreadsheets or databases
summary.what_it_does: TableTool detects CSV format specifications such as record delimiter, character encoding, decimal separator and quote style automatically when a file is opened. It can also let you set these specifications manually. Contents are displayed in a table view where cells, rows and columns can be edited in a grid-based interface. It can convert an existing CSV file to a different format. The app is released as open source under the MIT License with source code on GitHub.
notable: Automatic detection of CSV format specifications
Open source under the MIT License with code on GitHub
Grid-based editing of cells, rows and columns
caveats: Mac only, requires macOS 10.8 or later
Not enough ratings or reviews to show an overview on the App Store page
